messages:
maria.k: Heads up — console is showing weird metering spikes after the SDK rollout. Seen on tenant-alpha and a few canaries.
sam.platform: Thanks. Which SDK versions rolled out?
maria.k: python 0.12.3 and ts 1.8.0, same pattern across both.
jonathan.s: FWIW I spotted duplicated `x-route-intent` in the proxy access logs for some requests. Looks like header appears twice.
kevin.r: We added a small shim in 1.8 that rewrites route headers for backward compat. Possible collision.
devex-bot: deploy job 7890 finished for client-shim v1.8.0 :white_check_mark:
sam.platform: Can someone paste a minimal repro (curl + headers) so we can validate server vs client duplication?
maria.k: ```
# example from packet capture
GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
X-Route-Intent: rerank
X-Route-Intent: rerank
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
```
jonathan.s: Console ingestion groups by (model, route, tenant). Duplicate route headers -> double-counting in aggregation window.
kevin.r: Quick mitigation: SDK should dedupe route/meta headers before sending. I'll prepare a small patch for python shim.
sam.platform: Also add a test to ensure header canonicalization (case + duplicates) gets normalized.
maria.k: :thumbsup: We need backfill/exclusion for the affected ingestion window so billing/alerts don't misfire.
jonathan.s: I'll add an ingestion-side dry-run filter that flags duplicated-header requests but doesn't change totals yet.
kevin.r: Opening WIP PR now: https://github.com/redwoodinc/client-shim/pull/245 (will push fix for python shim)
devex-bot: CI job 245/compile failed — lint error in header-normalizer tests :x:
kevin.r: fixing lint, re-run in 5m.
sam.platform: Proposed rollout: patch + unit tests -> canary to 20% tenants -> ingestion dry-run for 6h -> evaluate -> full promote.
maria.k: If we need speed, we can hotfix console aggregator to ignore duplicate headers for counting only, then revert after SDK patch.
kevin.r: I'll prioritize the SDK fix but can do aggregator hotfix if it buys time.
maria.k: I'll draft a short support message and a console banner for affected customers. tagging @support once draft ready.
sam.platform: Good. Post-mortem notes: add a checklist item to SDK release process to run end-to-end telemetry smoke tests against console ingestion."
